L1_compression_infra.goal: Token/disk efficiency, search-time coherence, .mkm-memory integrity; not trading alpha.

L2_quant_inference_observation.goal: Market/advisory hypotheses, shadow promotion gates — separate from NLP compression gates.
success_metrics: Backtest IC, drawdown labels, independent_lens_shadow_gate decision cycle (observation)

fact_check_separation.verdict: Correct to separate: compression KPI path != KOSPI crash prediction; Logos/verse pipelines are governed by logos-first / regime rules, not by B/Ultra pilot JSON.
fact_check_separation.caveat: Garbage-in argument is qualitative: corrupted .mkm-memory would harm any downstream retrieval; it does not imply compression metrics equal fund performance.

fact_check_sensitive_integrity.claim: sensitive_integrity_ok false === regex error logs on disk
fact_check_sensitive_integrity.implementation: scripts/report_multilens_performance_eval.py::_sensitive_integrity — for each eval case, must_keep terms present in raw token set must appear in compressed token set; average across cases vs threshold 0.999 (quality_gate.sensitive_integrity_ok).
debugging_path: Open docs/final/artifacts/MULTILENS_ULTRA_COMPRESSION_ACTIVE_REPORT_V1.json compression_metrics.cases (or evaluate_report output) and filter cases where sensitive_integrity < 1.0
Adjust strategy/intensity/must_keep routing or compressor so required tokens survive — not log file tail from memory/

L1_backlog_merged.task: Sample expansion: random 500 .mkm-memory paths (or stratified by collection) through pilot_compress with fixed B/Ultra profile; record distribution of jaccard_raw_vs_reconstruct (not only mean).
L1_backlog_merged.blocked_by: Script support: optional --random-sample-seed on inventory CSV or new wrapper.

L1_backlog_merged.task: sensitive_integrity gate: enumerate failing bench cases from ACTIVE_REPORT; patch compressor or domain policy; re-run run_ultra_compression_default + KPI summary until sensitive_integrity_ok true or governance changes threshold (explicit decision).
4D revector throughput: batch N files under rehearsal out-dir, measure wall time and disk MB/s; set max batch size for future production job.
